action.objective: Commit the verified forced-mate knight check Nc6+ and continue converting the winning position.
action.rationale: Broad search covered all legal root moves at depth 3, and Nc6+ (e5c6) is the single commit_ready_move with exact evidence (score 99997, forced mate) and no proven refutation. Move facts confirm it gives check, captures nothing, faces no opponent captures after, and is defended by the bishop on d5. Safety.complete shows no mating reply, and tactical_refutation is not_found for the bounded checking-reply scope. No replan is required and no alternate candidate has comparable exact evidence, so committing Nc6+ is the strongest and safest choice.
